transcript.text:
If your oven has not come on after a power cut or if the clock is flashing, this is very often because the control panel has reset to 'Auto' mode, which prevents heating until you set it to 'Manual'. Please check two things:
1. Is the clock display flashing? If so, set the correct time and ensure the oven function is set to Manual (often a hand symbol) rather than Timed or Auto.
2. If the clock is not flashing but there are no lights at all on the panel, please check your consumer unit (fuse box) to see if a circuit breaker has tripped or an RCD has switched off for that circuit. Let me know what you find.
yes the clock is flashing 0.00 and a little symbol. how do i set the time? no manual

To set the time, look for a button labelled 'Clock', 'Time' or sometimes just a clock icon. Press it once; the hour digits should start flashing. Use '+' and '-' (or arrow) buttons to change them, then press 'Clock' again to move to minutes. Once you've entered the correct time, try turning the oven on as normal. If your model doesn't have separate '+' and '-' buttons, sometimes holding down a specific function button for 3 seconds enters setup mode—check your manual if possible. If the clock stays at 0.00 or won't change, the control panel may be faulty.
ok but which button is the clock one? there's no manual and i dont know what the buttons are called

It is very common for ovens to flash '0.00' after a power cut because they have reset into an automatic safety mode that stops the oven from heating until you set the time and switch it to Manual (often shown as a hand symbol). Since you don't have the manual, look for a button with a clock icon or labelled 'Clock', 'Time' or 'Timer'. If there is no dedicated button, try holding down the '+' and '-' buttons (or the two arrow buttons) together for 3–5 seconds; this often enters the time-setting mode on many brands. Once the hour digits start flashing, use the other buttons to set them, then press Clock/Time again to move to minutes.
I dont know which one is the clock, im not sure what the buttons are. can you just tell me what to press? its a Neff

On most Neff ovens, the clock is set by pressing and holding the 'Clock' button (often marked with a clock icon or just 'Clock') for about 3 seconds until the hour digits flash. Use the '+' and '-' buttons to change the time, then press 'Clock' again to confirm. Once done, ensure you select 'Manual' mode (usually a hand symbol) rather than Timed/Auto before trying to heat.
ok i pressed and held the one with the clock symbol and set the time. it came on and heated now. thanks

That is excellent news. It was just the safety reset after a power interruption; many ovens do this to prevent them from heating unexpectedly while you are setting up. To stop it happening again, try not to switch the oven off at the wall (the large isolator switch) unless necessary, as that will cut the power and trigger the same flashing clock. If it does happen again, just set the time and select 'Manual' mode to get back to normal. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
